submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, index 21 (La0.49Sb0.51, near LaSbO4) gave the highest EQE, about 7e-4 %. All three values are essentially zero, within the noise, so the La-Sb oxide line looks photo-inactive at 3.2 eV. I used XRD at x_Sb = 0.12, 0.26, 0.51 and 0.66 to check the line: the film peaks got stronger as Sb increased, and the constant peaks at Q = 4.55 and 5.33 are probably from the substrate. I then measured merit at three points spread along the line.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE of -8e-4 %: no photoresponse in the Sb-rich region
Measured EQE of -1.3e-4 %: no photoresponse near La3SbO7
Not measured because the merit budget was used up; wide-gap La2O3-type phases are unlikely to absorb at 3.2 eV
